# Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Diederik P. Kingma, Jimmy Ba  
**Year:** 2014  
**Journal:** arXiv  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1412.6980](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1412.6980)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.6980](https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.6980)

**Keywords:** adam, optimization, deep learning

## Abstract

We introduce Adam an algorithm for first-order gradient-based optimization of stochastic objective functions based on adaptive estimates of lower-order moments.
